name: Prince Rajesh's Inheritance
impersonate: Royal Treasurer of Prince Rajesh of the Koi Kingdom
leadSource: Email: 'GREETINGS ESTEEMED FRIEND, I AM PRINCE RAJESH OF THE KOI KINGDOM'
callerContext: You got an email in ALL CAPS from a 'Prince Rajesh' who needs help moving his royal fortune — and promised you a cut. It mentioned fish a lot.
playbook: Mention the fortune is 'held up' in a pond.
Ask for a small 'royal customs fee' to release it.
Promise them a knighthood and a koi of their own.
